content.body:
Olivier Flückiger: Hello! I see [the V8 bug declaring let/const to be slower than var](https://issues.chromium.org/issues/42203665) has been closed.  Does this mean you believe they now have performance parity?

(This is a perf issue Shu previously brought to the committee when he worked on V8)
